gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words in solid, tidy blocks. Megrim is best at angular, futuristic headings whose bars match their stems, while the sans body is best at wide channels into every counter.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-aldrich: Storybook nostalgia up top, then crisp modern lines. Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on its curves while Aldrich, set just below, keeps its x-height close to the cap height.
gen-nixie-one-gf-orbit: Retro-tech lines, nostalgic and open. Nixie One is best at open curves with clear gaps, while Orbit, the sans-serif body, is best at letters that float apart with rope-like stems.
